email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 45-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 0.5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-01-07.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter672@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
